entries.visual_spec:
[blocks/chat/chameleon/composer-attach-send] 卡: rounded-xl(=12) border border-stone-200 bg-white p-2.5(=10) shadow-[0_1px_2px_rgba(0,0,0,.03)]。Textarea: !border-0 !p-0 text-[12.5px] !shadow-none focus-visible:!ring-0 rows=2。底栏 mt-1.5 flex items-center gap-2; 发送 Button size=sm (Send h-3 w-3)+「发送」disabled=空; 停止 Button variant=ghost (Square h-3 w-3)+「停止」。附件按钮: h-7 w-7(=28) rounded-md border border-stone-200/70 bg-white text-stone-500; hover→border-amber-300 hover:bg-amber-50/40 hover:text-amber-700; (Paperclip h-3.5 w-3.5 或 Loader2 animate-spin); accept=image/*,audio/*,application/pdf multiple, max 20MB。AttachmentChip: rounded-md border border-stone-200/70 bg-stone-50/60 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px]; 图缩略 h-5 w-5 rounded object-cover; 名 max-w-[80px] truncate; X hover:bg-rose-100 hover:text-rose-600。

[blocks/chat/chameleon/playground-param-panel] 容器 space-y-3 text-[12.5px]。label mb-1 block text-stone-600。生成模式提示条: rounded-md border border-violet-200 bg-violet-50 px-2.5 py-2 text-[11px] leading-snug text-violet-700。NumberField: flex items-center justify-between gap-2; Input type=number !h-7 !w-20 text-right text-[12px] tnum; allowEmpty 时 0→placeholder='∞'。KB 多选: Select 触发显示「已选 N 个」; 已选 chip rounded-full bg-amber-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10.5px] text-amber-700 + ×移除。模板变量行: 变量名 chip rounded bg-stone-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10.5px] text-stone-600「{{name}}」 + Input !h-7 flex-1 text-[12px] placeholder「未填，将原样发送」。提示文案 mt-1 text-[10.5px] leading-tight text-stone-400。
descriptions: Playground 输入框：圆角白卡内嵌无边 Textarea(2行)，底部左侧附件按钮(presign→PUT→finalize 三步上传 + 缩略图 chip)、右侧发送/停止切换。Enter 发送、Shift+Enter 换行、输入法组词回车不拦截。对比模式 placeholder 改为广播提示。

Playground 列右栏运行设置：关联应用(AgentPicker，按 source 分流 comfyui→生成面板/local→运行真实应用/普通→预填模型提示词KB) + 模型 Select + System Prompt + 模板变量填值 + Temperature/TopP/MaxTokens 数字行 + 关联 KB 多选(amber chip 标签)。绑生成应用时整面板切换为 GenerationPanel + 紫色提示条。

entries.visual_spec: [blocks/chat/chameleon/embed-widget-bubble-shell] shadow DOM :host all:initial。气泡 bubble: width/height bubble_size(56,clamp40-96) border-radius 50% bg bubbleColor(#6366F1) color #fff box-shadow lg(0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.18)) hover:scale-1.06，icon size ≈47%；transparent 模式 bg/shadow 去除 + drop-shadow 描黑。tooltip line: bg paneBg border radius-14 padding 7px 12px max-w-220 shadow + bubble-tip-in .35s。panel: width panel_width(400,clamp280-520) height panel_height(600,clamp360-800) radius border_radius(12,clamp0-32) shadow lg，开态 opacity 1 translateY 0 scale 1 transition .18s；4 角位 bottom/top 96px。fullscreen: inset 0 100% 无圆角无阴影无 transform。header: padding 14px 16px bg headerBg(白自适应深色文字/深底白字 YIQ>175) + emoji 22px + title 14px/600 + sub 12px opacity .85。messages: padding 16 gap 12，msg max-w-88% gap-6。bubble-text: padding 9px 12px radius bubbleRadius=18 font panel(md 13.5px) line-height 1.6；user bg userBubble(themeColor) 白字 border-top-right-radius 4(tail)；bot bg botBubble border botBubbleBorder border-top-left-radius 4；error bg errorBg/text errorText。打字 typing 三点 6px 圆 typing 1.2s 上跳。citation-chip rounded-10 + citationBg/border。suggested-questions rounded-999 border themeColor hover 反色。composer: textarea radius-12 min-h-38 + focus border themeColor + soft shadow；send-btn 38x38 radius-12 bg themeColor + box-shadow rgba(99,102,241,.30) hover:scale-1.05；upload-btn 38x38 radius-10。sidebar overlay: inset 0 z-5 + sidebar-title::before 3px×14 竖条 themeColor + new-session-btn rounded-999 border themeColor55 + sidebar-item rounded-8 active bg themeColor14。brand 水印 11px center。dark 模式 paneBg #0F172A/paneText #F1F5F9/border #1E293B。@media≤480: panel calc(100vw-24)。
descriptions: 独立 vanilla-TS + shadow DOM 浮动气泡 + 对话面板：浮动圆气泡(4 角位 + tooltip 4 向/orbit) → 弹出 panel(header/messages/composer/brand 水印) + 历史会话 overlay 侧栏 + 附件 chips。全视觉由 admin ui_config 驱动(theme_color/header/font/shadow/radius/dark-auto)，fullscreen 模式供 iframe 复用。waveflow 无嵌入式 widget，全新的另一套表面。

entries.visual_spec: [blocks/chat/chameleon/hitl-human-input-prompt] 卡: mt-1.5 w-full max-w-[420px] rounded-xl(=12) border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50/60 p-3(=12)。标题行: mb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[12px] font-medium text-amber-700「⏸ 等待人工输入」。prompt: mb-2 whitespace-pre-wrap break-words text-[13px] text-stone-700。Textarea: rows=2 mb-2 text-[13px] placeholder「填写答案后提交，续跑该智能体…」。底部 flex justify-end Button size=sm disabled=!val.trim()「提交并续跑」。气泡内 paused 占位: text-amber-600「⏸ 等待人工输入…」。
descriptions: agent 经 ctx.ask_human 暂停 run 时，在该条 assistant 气泡下方渲染的琥珀色回填卡：展示 prompt + Textarea + 「提交并续跑」按钮，Cmd/Ctrl+Enter 提交，回填答案后续跑暂停的 run。Chameleon 独有(durable agent HITL)，waveflow 无。气泡本身 paused 态显示「⏸ 等待人工输入…」。

entries.visual_spec:
[blocks/chat/chameleon/markdown-message-lite] 根 div text-[13.5px] leading-relaxed break-words。p: mb-2(=8) last:mb-0。ul: list-disc space-y-0.5(=2) pl-5(=20); ol: list-decimal。a: text-sky-600(#0284c7) underline underline-offset-2 target=_blank。video(由 a/img href 匹配 /\.(mp4|webm|mov)/ 触发): my-1 max-h-[420px] max-w-full rounded-lg border border-stone-200。img: my-1 max-h-[420px] rounded-lg border border-stone-200 object-contain loading=lazy。h1 text-[15px]/h2 text-[14px]/h3 text-[13px] font-semibold mt-1。blockquote: border-l-2 border-stone-300 pl-2 text-stone-500。code(inline): rounded bg-stone-100 px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-[0.85em] text-stone-800。pre: overflow-x-auto rounded-md bg-stone-100 p-2.5(=10) font-mono text-[12px] [&>code]:bg-transparent。table: w-full border-collapse text-[12px]; th/td border border-stone-200 px-2 py-1。hr my-2 border-stone-200。

[blocks/chat/chameleon/citation-collapse-row] 容器: max-w-full space-y-1 px-1。每条 details: rounded-md border border-stone-200 bg-stone-50/80 px-2 py-1 text-[11px] text-stone-600。summary: cursor-pointer select-none truncate text-stone-500「📄 标题」。片段: mt-1 line-clamp-3 whitespace-pre-wrap text-stone-500。
descriptions: react-markdown + remark-gfm，把每个元素映射成紧凑 Tailwind 样式，给 assistant 气泡用。独有点：a/img 自动识别 .mp4/.webm/.mov → 渲染成内联 <video controls>；图片 lazy + max-h 约束防 reflow；代码/表格/引用全部走暖灰底而非默认。13.5px 基准字号专为气泡内紧凑排版。
agent 路径返回 citation 事件时，assistant 气泡下方渲染的引用条列表：每条 <details> 折叠，summary 显示 📄 标题/来源，展开显示 line-clamp-3 片段。与 widget/编辑器调试同水位。

entries.visual_spec: [blocks/chat/chameleon/message-actions-bar] 工具条: pointer-events-auto flex items-center gap-0.5(=2) rounded-md border border-stone-200/70 bg-white/90 p-0.5 shadow-sm backdrop-blur; opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-within:opacity-100。ActionBtn: rounded px-1 py-1 text-stone-500; hover→bg-stone-100 hover:text-stone-800; danger hover→bg-rose-50 hover:text-rose-600; active→bg-amber-100 text-amber-800(普通)/bg-rose-100 text-rose-700(danger); disabled→opacity-40。icon 统一 h-3 w-3(=12)。copied→Check h-3 w-3 text-emerald-600。⋯ 触发 MoreHorizontal h-3 w-3; DropdownMenuContent align=end min-w-[9rem]。MenuRow: flex items-center gap-2 icon(text-stone-500) + label text-[12.5px]。delete 菜单项前置 Separator, text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50。active 菜单项 text-amber-700。lucide: Copy/Pencil/RefreshCw/Trash2/ThumbsUp/ThumbsDown/Split/Languages/ArrowDownFromLine/Volume2/VolumeX/Download/Share2/Pin/PinOff/Check/MoreHorizontal。
descriptions: 单条消息 hover 浮现的玻璃质感动作条：主操作(copy/edit/regenerate/👍/👎)内联，次操作(continueGen/translate/tts/branching/pin/export/share/delete)收进 ⋯ DropdownMenu；translate 配语言列表时渲染为子菜单；copy/tts/export/share 自带默认实现；纯函数 resolve-actions 按 role+status 决定哪些可用、各落主条还是菜单(流式/HITL 暂停只留 copy)。跨 playground/conversations/widget 复用。

entries.visual_spec:
[blocks/chat/chameleon/message-list-bubble-thread] 外层 group flex gap-2(=8) isUser?flex-row-reverse:flex-row, stale→opacity-50。Bot 头像: mt-0.5 h-6 w-6(=24) shrink-0 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-violet-500(#8b5cf6) to-blue-500(#3b82f6) text-white, 内 Bot icon h-3.5 w-3.5(=14)。气泡容器: flex min-w-0 max-w-[88%] flex-col gap-1(=4) isUser?items-end:items-start。气泡本体: min-w-0 rounded-2xl(=16) px-3(=12) py-2(=8) text-[13px] leading-relaxed; user→rounded-tr-sm(=2) bg-blue-600(#2563eb) text-white; bot→rounded-tl-sm border border-stone-200 bg-white text-stone-800 shadow-[0_1px_2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]; failed→!border-rose-200 !bg-rose-50 !text-rose-700; pinned→ring-1 ring-amber-300。错误副行 mt-1 text-[12px] text-rose-600。footer: flex items-center gap-2(=8) px-1 text-[10px] text-stone-400; streaming标签 text-blue-600「生成中…」; usage tnum font-mono「↑{in} ↓{out}」; pinned📌 text-amber-600。hover 动作组 opacity-0 transition group-hover:opacity-100。trace 按钮 hover:bg-violet-50 hover:text-violet-600 (ListTree h-3 w-3); 存样本 hover:bg-emerald-50 hover:text-emerald-600 (BookmarkPlus); 改写提示词 hover:bg-violet-50 hover:text-violet-600 (Wand2)。空态: flex flex-1 items-center justify-center text-[12px] text-stone-400「输入消息开始对话」。VirtualList estimateSize=72 itemClassName=pb-4 px-4 pt-4。AttachmentPreview: 图 rounded-lg border border-stone-200/70 h-28 w-28(=112) object-cover hover:border-blue-300; 音频 audio controls h-8 max-w-[280px]; 文件 rounded-full border bg-stone-50/60 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] 📎前缀。

[blocks/chat/chameleon/playground-message-bubbles] VirtualList estimateSize 72 stickToBottom px-4 pt-4 itemClassName pb-4。MessageBubble: group flex gap-2(8)，user flex-row-reverse。bot 头像见 gradient-bot-avatar。气泡 rounded-2xl(16) px-3 py-2 text-[13px] leading-relaxed max-w-[88%]，user rounded-tr-sm(2) bg-blue-600 text-white / bot rounded-tl-sm border border-stone-200 bg-white text-stone-800 shadow-[0_1px_2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]，失败 !border-rose-200 !bg-rose-50 !text-rose-700，pinned ring-1 ring-amber-300。流式: mediaKind→ImageGenLoading / 否则 NeonLoader size sm「思考中…」。paused「⏸ 等待人工输入…」amber-600。citation details rounded-md border bg-stone-50/80 text-[11px] stone-600「📄 标题」。footer text-[10px] stone-400，用量 tnum font-mono「↑in ↓out」，动作 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100：trace ListTree hover:bg-violet-50/text-violet-600、存样本 BookmarkPlus hover:emerald、改写 Wand2 hover:violet。编辑态整条换 Textarea rounded-xl border。
descriptions: Playground/widget 共用的对话流：assistant 左侧带渐变 Bot 头像气泡(左上直角 tail)、user 右侧蓝实色气泡(右上直角 tail)；走 VirtualList 虚拟滚动 + stickToBottom 黏底；流式空内容显示 NeonLoader「思考中…」或 ImageGenLoading；附件预览(图/音频/文件 chip)、failed 态红气泡、pinned 琥珀 ring、footer 常显 token 用量(↑↓)、hover 浮现 trace/存样本/改写提示词入口。

气泡式消息流：bot 渐变头像 + 白底左上 tail 气泡 + Markdown，user blue-600 实色右上 tail，流式空内容显 NeonLoader「思考中…」或 ImageGenLoading，footer 常显用量 + hover 浮现 trace/存样本/改写动作，含 RAG 引用 details 条 + HITL 人工输入回填。虚拟滚动 stickToBottom。waveflow 无对话，全新。

entries.visual_spec: [blocks/display/chameleon/app-card-gallery-grid] 网格 grid-cols-1 sm:2 lg:3 xl:4 gap-3。卡片 group relative flex h-[148px](kb 132px) flex-col rounded-xl(12) border border-stone-200/80 bg-white p-4(16) shadow-sm transition hover:border-primary-200 hover:shadow-md。hover 高光线: absolute inset-x-4 top-0 h-0.5 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-primary-500 to-transparent opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 duration-300。图标块 h-9 w-9(36) rounded-lg group-hover:-rotate-6 group-hover:scale-105 duration-300，按 kind 着色(code indigo-50/600·chatflow sky·workflow violet·external amber)。名称 text-[13.5px] font-medium stone-900 + key font-mono text-[10.5px] stone-400。描述 line-clamp-2 text-[11.5px] leading-relaxed stone-500。底部徽标 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium(类型 kind 色 / 已发布 emerald-50-700 / 草稿 stone-100-500 / 已嵌入 blue-50-700) + 更新时间 stone-400。三点 MoreVertical h-7 w-7 opacity-0 group-hover。新建卡 h-[148px] rounded-xl border-dashed border-stone-300 bg-white/60 hover:border-blue-400 hover:bg-blue-50/40 hover:text-blue-600。骨架 .skeleton h-[148px] rounded-xl opacity-60。
descriptions: responsive 卡片网格：图标块(hover 旋转放大) + 名称 + key(mono) + 描述 + 类型徽标 + 状态(已发布/草稿/已嵌入) + 更新时间 + hover 顶部渐变高光线 + 悬浮三点菜单 + 起手虚线「新建」卡。agents(应用)/kbs 共用同一卡族。Dify 风网格，waveflow 是表格 shell，全新。
